items.label: Members back in 2025
items.note: No visit in 180 days, 5 dish groups

footnote: A/B tested on 20,000 members, 10,000 per arm, before rolling out to all 1.36 million
notes: Third, lapsed members. We had 1.36 million members who hadn't visited in 180 days. We used to send them all the same generic coupon, and 4.1% came back. My bet was that people don't return because nothing gives them a specific reason. So I grouped them by the dish they last ordered and sent a coupon for that dish. We tested it on 20,000 members first, then rolled it out. Across everyone, 9.8% came back, more than twice the generic rate, which is 134,000 members in 2025. Today that still takes three person-days a week of manual sends, and that's exactly why I want to turn it into a product.
